articles.summary: AbCellera (Nasdaq: ABCL) announced that the Company will present at the UBS Global Biopharma Conference on November 17, 2026. A live audio webcast of the presentation may be accessed through a link that will be posted on AbCellera's Investor Relations website . A replay will be available through the same link following the presentation. About AbCellera Biologics Inc. AbCellera (Nasdaq: ABCL) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing first-in-class antibody-based medicines in the areas of endocrinology, women’s health, immunology, oncology, and more. For more information, please visit www.abcellera.com . articles.summary: AbCellera (Nasdaq: ABCL) today announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026. All financial information in this press release is reported in U.S. dollars, unless otherwise indicated. “This was a transformative quarter for AbCellera, highlighted by strong clinical execution and balance sheet expansion. Positive top-line Phase 2 results for ABCL635 demonstrated an efficacy and tolerability profile that has potential to redefine the treatment of hot flashes.
